title: Thermal expansion mechanisms, heat transport, and band-gap renormalization in strongly anharmonic Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ from machine-learned interatomic potentials
title_zh: 根据机器学习的原子间势研究强非谐 Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba₃Lu(BO3)3 的热膨胀机制、热传输和带隙重正化
summary: Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 是结构复杂的材料，其热膨胀已在高温 X 射线衍射的基础上根据特定的多面体重排进行了解释。我们使用分子动力学研究它们的晶格动力学及其对热和电子性质的影响，并使用密度泛函理论数据训练的主动学习矩张量势。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ are structurally complex materials whose thermal expansion has been interpreted, on the basis of high-temperature x-ray diffraction, in terms of specific polyhedral rearrangements. We study their lattice dynamics and its consequences for thermal and electronic properties using molecular dynamics with actively learned moment tensor potentials trained on density-functional theory data. The anharmonicity measure σ^A (compares the anharmonic contribution to the interatomic forces with the total forces acting on atoms) reaches approx0.3-0.5 for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and approx0.75 for orientationally disordered α-Rb₂SO₄, and the imaginary harmonic modes of Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and α-Rb₂SO₄ are stabilized at finite temperature. The simulations reproduce the measured thermal expansion and support the mechanisms proposed from diffraction: expansion along c in β-Rb₂SO₄ arises from both elongation and straightening of corrugated Rb chains, BO₃ reorientation accompanies the anisotropic expansion of Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, and bending of polyhedral linkages limits expansion along the weakly expanding directions and in cubic Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃. Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivities differ by more than an order of magnitude between compounds with comparable σ^A, showing that the anharmonicity measure alone does not determine heat transport. Phonon-induced band-gap renormalization, including lattice thermal expansion, reaches 2.7 and 1.7 eV at 1250 K in Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and 1.4 eV at 650 K in β-Rb₂SO₄, with zero-point renormalizations of 0.64, 0.70, and 0.31 eV for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, respectively.

title: How good are universal MLIPs for alloys? A benchmark is only as trustworthy as its controls
title_zh: 适用于合金的通用 MLIP 效果如何？基准仅与其控制一样值得信赖
summary: 通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）根据 DFT 数据库的形成能量误差进行排名，就好像该数据库是真实的，但独立的 DFT 数据库不同意。我们将 145 万个有序金属间化合物的 14 个 uMLIP 与 AFLOW 进行了比较（没有经过任何训练），并将每个能量和稳定性误差与该分歧进行比较。对于一半的结构，AFLOW、Alexandria 和 OQMD 的差异小于 6-8 meV/原子，但少数结构的差异要大得多，将平均值提高到 16-30。这种分歧为任何模型的可测量误差设定了底限。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) are ranked by their formation-energy error against a DFT database, as if that database were ground truth, but independent DFT databases disagree. We benchmark fourteen uMLIPs on 1.45 million ordered intermetallics against AFLOW, which none trained on, and compare every energy and stability error with that disagreement. For half the structures, AFLOW, Alexandria, and OQMD differ by less than 6-8 meV/atom, but a minority differ by far more, raising the average to 16-30. That disagreement sets a floor on any model's measurable error. Re-referenced, the best uMLIP agrees with AFLOW as closely as Alexandria does, and the next four sit 2-7 meV/atom above the floor. Once broken elemental references are screened, the energy and stability rankings agree almost everywhere. Three apparent model failures shrink or vanish under the right control: poorly correlated shear moduli, thousands of "bad" DFT references, and the leader's inflated lead.

title: Concentration-Dependent Speciation in ZnCl2 Electrolyte Solutions: Transferability of Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials and Speciation Sensitivity of EXAFS
title_zh: ZnCl2 电解质溶液中的浓度依赖性形态：机器学习原子间势的可转移性和 EXAFS 的形态敏感性
summary: 预测浓电解质中的形态需要准确的离子相互作用和对缓慢相互转换的配位环境进行充分采样。我们使用机器学习原子间势将 Zn K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 测量与长时标分子动力学 (MD) 相结合，研究从稀释条件到 30 m 的 ZnCl2 水溶液。我们训练基于 revPBE 的 DeepMD 模型，其中包含或排除含 Zn 对的 D3 校正，并将它们与 DPMD-SCAN、经典 MD (CMD) 和 MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN 进行比较。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting speciation in concentrated electrolytes requires accurate ion interactions and adequate sampling of slowly interconverting coordination environments. We combine Zn K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) measurements with long-timescale molecular dynamics (MD) using machine-learning interatomic potentials to study aqueous ZnCl2 from dilute conditions to 30 m. We train revPBE-based DeepMD models with D3 corrections included or excluded for Zn-containing pairs and compare them with DPMD-SCAN, classical MD (CMD), and MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN. EXAFS calculations are benchmarked against hydrated and chloride-coordinated Zn reference complexes, then applied to MD ensembles alongside Zn-Cl coordination free-energy analysis. Increasing concentration reduces octahedral coordination, replaces water with chloride, and promotes chloride-bridged association. All three DeepMD models yield similar EXAFS at 3 m, but DPMD-SCAN shows greater transferability across concentrations, reproducing measured spectral trends, key features of mixed ZnCl2/LiCl spectra, and octahedral fractions consistent with other studies. DFT treatment strongly affects coordination free energies and aggregation; excluding Zn-related D3 corrections does not systematically improve EXAFS agreement. CMD shows larger spectral discrepancies and less consistent coordination trends. MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN improves upon CMD and yields spectra comparable to DPMD-SCAN, which provides more consistent agreement and greater computational efficiency. Neighbor-resolved analysis shows that distance disorder and scattering-path interference can produce similar EXAFS signatures for distinct coordination ensembles, highlighting the need for rigorous sampling and ensemble-averaged spectra to distinguish isolated from chloride-bridged Zn species.

title: PYTHIA, a transferable machine learning framework for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization
title_zh: PYTHIA，一种可迁移的机器学习框架，用于同时优化缺陷和吸附位点
summary: 机器学习已经渗透到材料优化中，提供了高价值。然而，它对大量样本的依赖限制了它对相对探索的材料族的适用性。在本文中，我们通过 PYTHIA（概率可转移分层交互架构）框架将机器学习的适用性扩展到新颖和待研究的材料。 Pythia 利用两个最强大的机器学习概念：基础模型和迁移学习。我们采用一个复杂的基础模型，在化学相似分子的大型数据集上进行训练，其目标在物理上接近我们的预测目标。然后，我们冻结权重并使用变换器层执行子空间对齐，并使用高斯过程添加不确定性量化。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning has permeated material optimization, providing high value. Nevertheless, its re- liance on a high number of samples limits its applicability to relatively explored material families. In this paper we extend the applicability of machine learning to novel and understudied materials through the PYTHIA (Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture) framework. Pythia utilizes two of the most powerful machine learning concepts, foundational models and transfer learning. We employ a complex foundational model trained on a large dataset of chemically similar molecules, on a target that is physically close to our prediction target. Then, we freeze the weights and perform subspace alignment with the use of a transformer layer and add uncertainty quantification with gaussian processes. These two layers can be trained on a limited dataset yet allow us to leverage the gained knowl- edge and the studied materials and complex architectures. The resulting model is used as a surrogate for a Bayesian Optimization scheme. To showcase the robustness of the framework, we applied it to the investigation of adsorption and defect optimization of two distinct systems. title: Unconstrained learning of equivariant atomistic properties
title_zh: 等变原子性质的无约束学习
summary: 基于图神经网络（ GNN ）的机器学习原子间势已成为势能面（ PES ）的第一原理精度例程。它们的主干，通常是O (3) -在设计上等价的，越来越多地用于学习其他原子特性。其中许多具有高角度顺序或假张量特征，定义为每个原子，或在大原子中心的基准集上扩展。这种靶标会使等变量GNN产生应变，其张量积随着角度顺序的变化而急剧增长，如果被截断，则可能无法代表靶标，从而迫使超参数之间难以权衡。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials based on graph neural networks (GNNs) have made first-principles accuracy routine for the potential energy surface (PES). Their backbones, often O(3)-equivariant by design, are increasingly used to learn other atomistic properties. Many of these are of high angular order or pseudotensorial character, defined per atom, or expanded on large atom-centered basis sets. Such targets strain equivariant GNNs, whose tensor products grow steeply in cost with angular order and can fail to represent the target if truncated, forcing difficult trade-offs between hyperparameters. Unconstrained models like the Point-Edge Transformer (PET) instead replace explicit O(3) algebra with edge-to-edge attention and learn equivariance from data, so that the same backbone can in principle learn any equivariant property. We demonstrate how to use PET to learn molecular dipoles and polarizabilities, NMR chemical shielding tensors, and auxiliary-basis expansions of the electron density. Increasing the backbone size systematically improves both accuracy and equivariance error, and targeted architectural and training choices reduce the symmetry breaking further. PET matches or improves on the released reference models at lower inference cost and, compared with equivariant models, a smaller memory footprint. The predictions give accurate IR and Raman spectra and isotropic shieldings; the predicted densities accelerate self-consistent field calculations and give one-shot ground-state properties, and pretrained density models transfer to higher levels of theory by fine-tuning on little data. The impact of approximate equivariance is small for most observables, further validating this approach to train fast, accurate, and useful surrogate models for properties beyond the PES.

title: Physics-informed latent space dynamics identification for time-dependent NLTE atomic kinetics
title_zh: 基于物理的潜在空间动力学识别，用于时间相关的 NLTE 原子动力学
summary: 非局部热力学平衡（NLTE）计算仍然是辐射流体动力学的主要计算瓶颈，而大多数现有的机器学习替代方法将 NLTE 视为静态输入输出映射而不是动力学演化问题。在这里，我们提出了一种专门为 NLTE 原子动力学设计的物理信息潜在空间动力学识别框架，该框架通过显式简化的控制方程捕获非平衡等离子体的时间依赖性原子动力学。为了确保简化模型的物理可靠性，我们施加了物理信息损失项，以增强宏观一致性、动态稳定性以及在长时间积分过程中收敛到正确的稳态。
abstract: Non-local thermodynamic equilibrium (NLTE) calculations remain a major computational bottleneck in radiation–hydrodynamics, while most existing machine-learning surrogates treat NLTE as a static input–output mapping rather than a kinetic evolution problem. Here, we present a physics-informed latent space dynamics identification framework specifically designed for NLTE atomic kinetics, which captures the time-dependent atomic kinetics of non-equilibrium plasmas through an explicit reduced governing equation. To ensure the physical reliability of the reduced model, we impose physics-informed loss terms that enforce macroscopic consistency, dynamical stability, and convergence to the correct steady state during long-time integration. Applied to tin NLTE population data generated along hydrodynamically modeled temperature–density trajectories relevant to extreme ultraviolet lithography plasmas, the model accurately reproduces charge-state evolution and mean charge state with errors below 2%, achieves speedups of approximately – , and remains stable beyond the training time window under fixed plasma conditions by converging toward physically admissible states and the correct steady-state solution. These results show that careful physics-informed design of the latent dynamics, rather than data fitting alone, is essential for constructing fast, stable, and physically reliable surrogates with long-time consistency for time-dependent NLTE kinetics.

title: Meta-learning of Gibbs states for many-body Hamiltonians with applications to Quantum Boltzmann Machines
title_zh: 多体哈密顿量的吉布斯态元学习及其在量子玻尔兹曼机中的应用
summary: 量子吉布斯态的制备是量子计算中的一个基本挑战，对于从建模开放量子系统到量子机器学习等应用至关重要。基于 Cervera-Lierta 等人提出的元变分量子本征求解器框架。和问题驱动的 ansatz 设计，我们引入了两种元学习算法：元变分量子热化器 (Meta-VQT) 和神经网络 Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT)，用于在嘈杂的中尺度量子 (NISQ) 设备上进行参数化哈密顿量的高效热状态准备。
abstract: arXiv:2507.16373v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The preparation of quantum Gibbs states is a fundamental challenge in quantum computing, essential for applications ranging from modeling open quantum systems to quantum machine learning. Building on the Meta-Variational Quantum Eigensolver framework proposed by Cervera-Lierta et al. and a problem-driven ansatz design, we introduce two meta-learning algorithms: Meta-Variational Quantum Thermalizer (Meta-VQT) and Neural Network Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT) for efficient thermal state preparation of parametrized Hamiltonians on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. Meta-VQT utilizes a fully quantum ansatz, while NN Meta-VQT integrates a quantum--classical hybrid architecture. Both use collective optimization over a finite set of training parameter values to prepare approximate Gibbs states at held-out parameter values within the sampled parameter domain. We validate our methods on Transverse Field Ising Models (TFIM) with up to eight qubits and on a two-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms. Within these finite-size benchmarks, the trained models accurately prepare thermal states at test points inside the training interval. For the six and eight qubit cases of TFIM, meta-learned parameters when combined with appropriately designed ansatz serve as warm-start initializations, significantly outperforming random initializations in the optimization tasks. Furthermore, a 3 qubit Kitaev ring example showcases our algorithm's effectiveness across finite-temperature crossover regimes. Finally, we apply our algorithms to train a Quantum Boltzmann Machine (QBM) on a 2-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms, achieving enhanced training efficiency, improved Gibbs state accuracy, and a 30-fold runtime speedup over existing techniques such as variational quantum imaginary time (VarQITE)-based QBM highlighting the practicality of meta-algorithm-based QBMs.

title: Scalable Neural Wave Functions via Information Mixing and Hierarchical Network Architectures
title_zh: 通过信息混合和分层网络架构实现可扩展的神经波函数
summary: 数值模拟量子多体系统是现代物理学的核心挑战之一，因为希尔伯特空间随系统尺寸呈指数增长，使得大规模精确解决方案变得棘手。在过去的十年中，生成人工神经网络已经成为强大的波函数分析，推动了寻找基态表示、从数据重建量子态以及量子多体系统动力学建模方面的进步。虽然循环神经网络 (RNN) 的计算效率很高，但循环性质会限制其捕获远程相关性的能力。具有底层自注意力机制的 Transformer 模型擅长捕获这些远程相关性，但会增加计算要求，从而限制了小型物理系统的应用。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30257v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Numerically simulating quantum many-body systems is one of the central challenges in modern physics, as the exponential growth of the Hilbert space with system size renders large-scale exact solutions intractable. Over the past decade, generative artificial neural networks have emerged as powerful wave function ansätze that have powered advances in finding ground state representations, reconstructing quantum states from data, and modeling dynamics in quantum many-body systems. While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are computationally efficient, the recurrent nature can limit their capacity to capture long-range correlations. Transformer models with their underlying self-attention mechanism excel at capturing these long-range correlations, but incur increased computational requirements, restricting applications to small physical systems. In this work, we address these limitations by exploring the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) mixer model as a wave function ansatz. By mixing information globally and locally through the system via a computationally lightweight mixing strategy, this architecture promises to combine the ability to capture long-range correlations with low computational costs. We benchmark the model on finding ground state representations of two-dimensional quantum many-body systems in various phases of matter and investigate the behavior of representational accuracy and computational efficiency for different physical system sizes. By comparing its performance to RNNs and transformer models with single-site and patched input definitions, we demonstrate that the MLP mixer architecture performs competitively with state-of-the-art network models. We further show that a hierarchical combination of this model with the transformer model outperforms other state-of-the-art architectures for large-scale quantum systems, opening new avenues for investigating quantum phases of matter.

title: Charge Density Waves and In-Gap States in Coupled Chains and Moiré Superlattices
title_zh: 耦合链和莫尔超晶格中的电荷密度波和带隙态
summary: 电荷密度波 (CDW) 由电子和晶格畸变之间的相互作用产生，是低维系统的标志。在这里，我们研究了耦合的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链，包括晶格匹配的梯子和晶格失配的莫尔超晶格，并发现了一组丰富的 CDW 相以及对称保护的束缚态。在晶格匹配链中，电子声子耦合和链间隧道效应之间的竞争驱动了一系列 CDW 相，包括交错的二聚体、三聚体和不通约态。这些相通常是有间隙的，主束缚态受到晶体对称性而不是手性对称性的保护，因此不会被固定到零能量。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge density waves (CDWs) arise from the interplay between electrons and lattice distortions and are a hallmark of low-dimensional systems. Here we study coupled Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains, both lattice-matched ladders and lattice-mismatched moiré superlattices, and find a rich set of CDW phases together with symmetry-protected bound states. In lattice-matched chains, the competition between electron-phonon coupling and interchain tunneling drives a sequence of CDW phases, including staggered dimers, trimers, and incommensurate states. These phases are generally gapped and host bound states protected by crystalline symmetries rather than chiral symmetry, and are therefore not pinned to zero energy. Lattice mismatch further reconstructs these phases into long-period supermoiré CDWs, with an ordered array of defects, pinned to the moiré length scale, that host localized electronic states. Interchain tunneling and lattice mismatch thus emerge as natural control parameters for CDW order and bound states in one-dimensional chains.

title: Decoding Composition-Structure-Performance Relations in Sodium Layered Oxide Positive Electrode Materials
title_zh: 解读钠层状氧化物正极材料的成分-结构-性能关系
summary: 层状钠过渡金属 (TM) 氧化物 NaₓTMO2 是最有前途的钠离子正极材料之一，但其 Na/空位排序、层堆叠顺序和协同 Jahn-Teller 畸变仅在少数单 TM 化合物中为人所知。我们将早期研究中报告的Na/空位排序编译成包含41种独特排序的单一库，并将其统一应用于五个单TM和所有十个NaₓTM₀.₅TM'₀.₅O2氧化物（TM = Ti、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni），在1,025次准确的第一原理计算之前筛选了超过120,000个具有机器学习原子间势的结构。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered sodium transition-metal (TM) oxides, NaₓTMO₂, are among the most promising sodium-ion positive electrode materials, yet their Na/vacancy orderings, layer stacking sequences, and cooperative Jahn--Teller distortions are known only for a few single-TM compounds. We compile the Na/vacancy orderings reported in earlier studies into a single library of 41 unique orderings and apply this uniformly to five single-TM and all ten NaₓTM₀.₅TM'₀.₅O₂ oxides (TM = Ti, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni), screening more than 120,000 structures with machine-learning interatomic potentials prior to 1,025 accurate first-principles calculations. The phase diagrams explain the observed O3/P3/O1 sequences and voltages, and the O3-to-P3 competition hinges on ordering energies of a few meV per atom that scalar descriptors, such as the cationic potential and the interlayer-slab distance, miss. Our extensive analysis reveals that the redox couples form a nearly partner-independent ladder, Ti³⁺/⁴⁺ < Mn³⁺/⁴⁺ < Co³⁺/⁴⁺ < Ni²⁺/³⁺ < Fe³⁺/⁴⁺, explaining pristine charge transfer and the oxidation sequence. Van Vleck analysis of every TMO₆ octahedron reveals that TM mixing suppresses the cooperative Jahn--Teller distortions of Mn³⁺ and Ni³⁺ through charge transfer to Jahn--Teller-inactive states or dilution of Jahn--Teller-active centers. We formulate an energy-density-versus-strain map that yields a design rule: a high-voltage couple without Jahn--Teller strain, which Mn⁴⁺/Ni²⁺ charge transfer realizes in NaₓMn₀.₅Ni₀.₅O₂, the most practical composition. We release the ordering-resolved dataset as a training set for subsequent training of accurate machine-learning interatomic potentials.

title: Fixed-Dimensional Latent Flow for Generating Variable-Size 3D Molecules
title_zh: 用于生成可变尺寸 3D 分子的固定维度潜流
summary: 分子尺寸本质上与组成、结构和性质相关，但大多数 3D 分子生成器将尺寸视为预定义的输入，而不是要生成的数量。我们引入了无等变变压器自动编码潜在流匹配，这是一个两阶段框架，它使用流匹配对固定维潜在向量进行采样，并采用自回归变压器来确定分子大小、原子类型、坐标和化学属性。规范原子排序和刚性姿势对齐使 Transformer 无需等变层，而解码属性则指导键重建。
abstract: arXiv:2609.08333v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Molecular size is intrinsically linked to composition, structure, and properties, but most 3D molecular generators treat size as a predefined input rather than a quantity to be generated. We introduce Equivariant-Free Transformer-Autoencoded Latent Flow Matching, a two-stage framework that samples a fixed-dimensional latent vector using flow matching and employs an autoregressive Transformer to determine molecular size, atom types, coordinates, and chemical attributes. Canonical atom ordering and rigid-pose alignment enable Transformers without equivariant layers, while decoded attributes guide bond reconstruction. On PCQM4Mv2, unconditional generation yields 87.9% unique and novel molecules passing sanitization and PoseBusters checks, exceeding baselines with lower end-to-end training and sampling time and higher end-to-end throughput. Across ten target HOMO-LUMO gaps, internal ranking retains 30% of the screened candidates and increases the density functional theory-verified hit rate within 0.1 eV of the target from 25.0% to 52.4%, while largely preserving novelty and diversity. These results demonstrate fixed-dimensional latent generation with autoregressive decoding as a practical approach to molecular design without prespecifying size.

title: Accurate vector magnetometer via Zeeman Rabi oscillations
title_zh: 通过塞曼拉比振荡精确矢量磁力计
summary: 作者：T. S. Menon、D. P. Hewatt、C. Kiehl、M. Ellmeier、S. Knappe 和 C. A. Regal 磁场方向的精确测量对于从磁导航到空间科学的各种应用至关重要，但利用紧凑型光泵磁力计 (OPM) 实现高角度精度仍然具有挑战性。作者展示了一种基于微型铷蒸气池中射频驱动的塞曼拉比振荡的矢量 OPM。通过将校准的射频场与基于 Floquet 的原子模型相结合，他们使用单光轴实现了平均角度精度为 80 μrad 的无死区矢量测量。
abstract: Author(s): T. S. Menon, D. P. Hewatt, C. Kiehl, M. Ellmeier, S. Knappe, and C. A. Regal Accurate measurements of magnetic field direction are essential for applications ranging from magnetic navigation to space science, yet achieving high angular accuracy with compact optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs) remains challenging. The authors demonstrate a vector OPM based on radio-frequency-driven Zeeman Rabi oscillations in a microfabricated rubidium vapor cell. By combining calibrated radio-frequency fields with a Floquet-based atomic model, they achieve dead-zone-free vector measurements with a mean angular accuracy of 80 μrad using a single optical axis. This is a promising route toward compact, high-accuracy OPMs that can be integrated into existing architectures. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 044073] Published Fri Oct 23, 2026

title: Exact few-magnon Bethe scars of the non-integrable alternating Heisenberg chain
title_zh: 不可积交替海森堡链的精确少磁振子贝特疤痕
summary: 量子晶格模型的精确解可以为解释凝聚态物质系统中的物理现象提供有用的指导。可积性的突出例子出现在一维，包括海森堡链，其中 Bethe ansatz 方法取得了广泛的成功。最近的研究指出，某些不可积模型具有量子多体疤痕态，这些态形成隐藏在混沌光谱中的规则态的超自旋。
abstract: arXiv:2501.14017v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin of regular states hidden in an otherwise chaotic spectrum. Here we consider one of the simplest examples of a non-integrable model, the alternating ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (bond-staggered) Heisenberg chain, a close cousin of the spin-1 Haldane chain and a spin analog of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and show the presence of exponentially many zero-energy states. We highlight features of the alternating chain that allow treatment with the coordinate Bethe ansatz (with important modifications), and surprisingly, for a non-integrable system, we find simple compact expressions for zero-energy eigenfunctions for a few magnons, including solutions with fractionalized particle momentum. These states exhibit wavefunction scarring similar to that of single-particle states in chaotic billiards. We discuss a general numerical recipe to diagnose the existence of such generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) scar states and also provide exact analytic expressions for their entanglement. We conclude by conjecturing a picture of magnon pairing which may generalize to multiple magnons. Our work opens the avenue to describe certain eigenstates of partially integrable systems using the GBA.

title: Interaction-enhanced antiferromagnetic correlations in a Kondo ladder with a gapped band structure
title_zh: 具有带隙结构的近藤梯中相互作用增强的反铁磁相关性
summary: 我们使用密度矩阵重整化群方法研究两腿 Kondo-Hubbard 梯中的磁相关性。我们重点关注非相互作用电子系统具有窄间接带隙的参数范围。在这个体系中，不存在费米面，传统的基于费米面的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida图不能直接适用；随着非相互作用带隙的增加，局部自旋之间的磁相关性变得更弱。我们发现适度的现场库仑相互作用增强了局部自旋之间的反铁磁相关性。这种增强在铁磁和反铁磁近藤耦合中都会出现，在边缘钉扎场引起的交错磁化强度中也可以看到。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate magnetic correlations in the two-leg Kondo-Hubbard ladder using the density-matrix renormalization group method. We focus on a parameter regime in which the noninteracting electronic system has a narrow indirect band gap. In this regime, there is no Fermi surface, and the conventional Fermi-surface-based Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida picture is not directly applicable; magnetic correlations between localized spins become weaker as the noninteracting band gap increases. We find that a moderate on-site Coulomb interaction enhances the antiferromagnetic correlations between localized spins. This enhancement, which is also seen in the staggered magnetization induced by a pinning field at the edges, occurs for both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Kondo couplings. Our results show that electron-electron interactions can enhance magnetic correlations between localized spins even when the underlying noninteracting electronic structure is gapped, suggesting an interaction-driven route to magnetic instabilities in narrow-gap Kondo-lattice systems.

title: Quantum geometry and quantum capacitance in the orbital magneto-electric effect
title_zh: 轨道磁电效应中的量子几何和量子电容
summary: 轨道磁电效应（OME），即通过电场产生稳态轨道角动量（OAM）密度，是轨道电子学的核心组成部分。然而，它的微观解释由于存在两种性质不同的贡献而变得复杂：带内埃德尔斯坦项源于平衡OAM和费米表面位移的综合效应，以及带间贡献源于电场引起的Zitterbewegung。在这里，我们在布洛赫电子 OAM 的现代理论框架内开发了 OME 的教学密度矩阵公式，其中两个贡献自然地从密度矩阵的不同部分中出现，并且可以清楚地看到它们不同的量子几何结构。
abstract: arXiv:2505.02911v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The orbital magneto-electric effect (OME), the generation of a steady-state orbital angular momentum (OAM) density by an electric field, is a central component of orbitronics. Nevertheless its microscopic interpretation is complicated by the existence of two qualitatively different contributions: the intra-band Edelstein term stemming from the combined effect of the equilibrium OAM and Fermi surface shift, and the inter-band contribution, stemming from Zitterbewegung induced by the electric field. Here we develop a pedagogical density-matrix formulation of the OME within the framework of the modern theory of Bloch-electron OAM, in which the two contributions naturally emerge from distinct parts of the density matrix, and their distinct quantum geometric structures are clearly seen. In the inter-band contribution, in addition to the local- and itinerant-circulation terms, we show that a band-diagonal displacement, or charge dipole, is present, which is linear in the electric field and governed by the normalized quantum metric. For a tilted massive Dirac cone the Zitterbewegung OME and the Fermi-surface orbital response occur for orthogonal electric-field orientations, providing a route to separate them experimentally. The itinerant-circulation contribution is identical to the dipolar one, so in a two-band model the dipole accounts for exactly half of the inter-band response, both in the doped regime and in the insulating gap. Our recent insights identify quantum-metric engineering as a route for enhancing orbital magneto-electric responses and clarify the relation between modern orbital magnetization, polarization, and orbital torque phenomenology.

title: π-Flux Tuning of Quantum Paramagnetism in the Triangular-Lattice Hubbard Model
title_zh: 三角晶格哈伯德模型中量子顺磁性的 π 通量调谐
summary: 我们比较了半填充时的两个时间反转对称三角晶格哈伯德模型：零通量模型和交错 π 通量模型，其中零通量和 π 通量穿过相反方向的三角形。尽管两者在强耦合极限的前导阶上都简化为相同的海森堡模型，但它们不同的电荷涨落曲线产生了不同的量子顺磁状态。将强耦合展开式与无限密度矩阵重正化群（iDMRG）计算相结合，我们发现零通量模型的正环交换促进了自发手性，与其中间耦合时手性自旋液体的概念一致。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare two time-reversal-symmetric triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling: the zero-flux model and a staggered π-flux model with zero and π flux through oppositely oriented triangles. Although both reduce to the same Heisenberg model at leading order in the strong-coupling limit, their distinct charge fluctuation profiles yield different quantum paramagnetic regimes. Combining a strong-coupling expansion with infinite density matrix renormalization group (iDMRG) calculations, we find that the positive ring-exchange of the zero-flux model promotes spontaneous chirality, consistent with its notion of a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling. In the staggered-π-flux model, whose noninteracting limit is a Dirac semimetal, the ring exchange changes sign and disfavors chiral order and we find no resolvable scalar chirality. This renders flux-tuned ring-exchange an efficient discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling.

title: Anomalous polar chains in halide perovskites
title_zh: 卤化物钙钛矿中的异常极性链
summary: 几十年来，人们对铁电钙钛矿中的局部极性扭曲、它们的集体排序以及它们的场驱动反转进行了广泛的研究。在这里，我们利用大规模分子动力学和第一性原理训练的原子间势，发现了铁电卤化物钙钛矿 CsGeBr3 的异常行为。在其名义上的立方相中，Ge 偏心形成一维极性链，延伸至少数十纳米并在纳秒时间尺度上弛豫，比 BaTiO3 和 PbTiO3 慢四个数量级，CsSnBr3 位于其间。
abstract: arXiv:2610.31184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local polar distortions, their collective ordering, and their field-driven reversal have been studied extensively in ferroelectric perovskites for decades. Here we identify an unusual behavior in the ferroelectric halide perovskite CsGeBr3 using large-scale molecular dynamics with first-principles-trained interatomic potentials. In its nominally cubic phase the Ge off-centering forms one-dimensional polar chains that extend over at least tens of nanometers and relax on nanosecond timescales, four orders of magnitude slower than in BaTiO3 and PbTiO3, with CsSnBr3 in between. The cubic CsGeBr3 phase is a dynamically disordered state in which oppositely polarized chains flip throughout the crystal, and a long-lived one-dimensional local polarization coexists with zero net polarization. A simple three-dimensional perovskite thus hosts long-ranged one-dimensional polar correlations with remarkably slow dynamics. In the ferroelectric phase the same chains set a one-dimensional switching mechanism, in which the polarization reverses chain by chain.
